six_cycles.cache_action: delete cached /rel/ body from both stores, preserve metadata/notes
retain all; failure then one bounded recovery attempt under new source revision
six_cycles.note: One scheduled cycle with two preserved phases/attempts, not seven favorable independent cycles.

http_policy.body_encoding: exact UTF-8 bytes from snapshot, no transformation
http_policy.etag: quoted SHA256 of actually served bytes for each URL, not advertised manifest digest; conditional matching returns304
http_policy.manifest_discovery: Both arms may use same manifest/fingerprint; no relation-identifier dereference needed
http_policy.not_found: all unlisted local paths404; no redirects/external follow
http_policy.response_headers: record exact harness-generated headers/bytes; include MIME and ETag; do not treat local response cost as free

synthetic_provenance: All scenario manifests use isolated fixture revs100..104, never production state. Relevant body edits and deployment failure/recovery are evaluator-authored local facts only. Raw source directory remains exact committed bytes.
